knobs.name: countT0
knobs.what: s: second the first roll lands on the table (the lane is empty before it)

knobs.name: countT1
knobs.what: s: second the last of the rolls lands (the count reads all of them by 24.0)

knobs.name: countWin
knobs.what: share of the rolls that are still settling at once during the count-in (larger = softer front)

knobs.name: hotFlash
knobs.what: how long a newly landed roll stays bright, as a factor of the settling window

knobs.name: waffPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the 500 x 200 field of rolls on the table

knobs.name: waffFill
knobs.what: share of the field spacing a mark fills (smaller = more felt between marks)

knobs.name: cubePitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the stacked marks (one box per roll); scales every stack

knobs.name: cubeFill
knobs.what: share of the stack spacing a box fills (smaller = a visible seam between rolls)

knobs.name: fdW
knobs.what: boxes across one first-die stack (the six stacks)

knobs.name: fdD
knobs.what: boxes deep in one first-die stack

knobs.name: fdGap
knobs.what: world units: air between the six first-die stacks

knobs.name: sumW
knobs.what: boxes across one sum stack (26 stacks; with sumGap it sets the width of the bell)

knobs.name: sumD
knobs.what: boxes deep in one sum stack (fewer = taller bell)

knobs.name: sumGap
knobs.what: world units: air between the 26 sum stacks

knobs.name: fd0
knobs.what: s: the first roll leaves the field for its first-die stack (arrival order)

knobs.name: fdSpread
knobs.what: s: from the first roll leaving to the last roll leaving (fd0 + fdSpread + fdFly <= 33.6)

knobs.name: fdFly
knobs.what: s: flight time of one roll from the field to its stack

knobs.name: fdLift
knobs.what: world units: hop height of a roll in flight to the first-die stacks

knobs.name: sum0
knobs.what: s: the first roll leaves its first-die stack for its sum stack

knobs.name: sumSpread
knobs.what: s: from the first roll leaving to the last (sum0 + sumSpread + sumFly <= 47.4)

knobs.name: sumFly
knobs.what: s: flight time of one roll to its sum stack

knobs.name: sumLift
knobs.what: world units: hop height of a roll in flight to the sum stacks

knobs.name: diceT0
knobs.what: s: the first of the five dice lands

knobs.name: diceStep
knobs.what: s: between one die landing and the next

knobs.name: diceSize
knobs.what: sheet units: edge of a die in the hook

knobs.name: sumAt
knobs.what: s: the sum of the throw appears

knobs.name: flatAt
knobs.what: s: the belief's flat line appears over the empty 5-30 axis

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the hook throw starts to fade (gone 0.8 s later)

knobs.name: landAt
knobs.what: s: the running counter is replaced by the landed count (never before the count-in ends)

knobs.name: pinsFirstAt
knobs.what: s: the six first-die counts pin on their stacks

knobs.name: pinsFirstOut
knobs.what: s: the first-die pins start to fade

knobs.name: equalAt
knobs.what: s: the equal-odds line (3,846 per sum) appears over the sum stacks

knobs.name: pinsSumAt
knobs.what: s: the peak and end counts pin on their stacks (after the side view lands)

knobs.name: tailLitAt
knobs.what: s: the five tail stacks start to turn accent (1.2 s ramp)

knobs.name: pinsTailAt
knobs.what: s: the five tail counts pin on their stacks

knobs.name: volIn
knobs.what: s: the cross-fade from the stacks to the counted cells starts

knobs.name: volFade
knobs.what: s: length of that cross-fade

knobs.name: volBuild
knobs.what: s: the cells grow in over this long, left to right

knobs.name: volStagger
knobs.what: share of the build window one cell takes (1 = all at once)

knobs.name: volAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of a counted cell (the cut plane shows through lower values)

knobs.name: volCutDim
knobs.what: opacity factor of the cells the cut has passed

knobs.name: cutT0
knobs.what: s: the cut starts at sum 5

knobs.name: cutT1
knobs.what: s: the cut reaches the 25 / 26 edge (the tail count lands at tailAt)

knobs.name: tailAt
knobs.what: s: the tail cells light and the tail count lands (count 2)

knobs.name: ratioAt
knobs.what: s: the share appears under the tail count (always after it)

knobs.name: beliefAt
knobs.what: s: the equal-odds line and its tail box return

knobs.name: timesAt
knobs.what: s: "about 12 times too many" appears

knobs.name: exactT0
knobs.what: s: the exact bell (expected rolls per sum) starts drawing, left to right

knobs.name: exactT1
knobs.what: s: the exact bell is drawn

knobs.name: waysAt
knobs.what: s: the ways of 7,776 appear

knobs.name: tailExactAt
knobs.what: s: the exact tail (126 ways predict 1,620) appears

knobs.name: agreeAt
knobs.what: s: the agreement lines (largest gap, mean, sd) appear

knobs.name: cutOffAt
knobs.what: s: the cut plane is put away (the passed cells undim; the tail stays lit)

knobs.name: mondayAt
knobs.what: s: the cells fade and the rolls return for Monday

knobs.name: bandAt
knobs.what: s: the middle band (sums 14 to 21) lights

knobs.name: bandDim
knobs.what: how far rolls outside the band fade toward muted (1 = all the way)

knobs.name: feltMargin
knobs.what: world units: felt around the field of rolls

knobs.name: readSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the tail count (must-read, display face)

knobs.name: ratioSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the share under the tail count (must-read)

knobs.name: pinSub
knobs.what: sheet units: small line under a pin (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: labHold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: labLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: pin leader length

knobs.name: exactW
knobs.what: sheet units: stroke of the exact bell line
